checkpoints.name: scenario-41-prebattle-menu
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: Strict mGBA 0.10.5 replay held this tracked state for 80 frames with no input and preserved the exact prebattle-menu scanlines. Task 2 resumes at 0x08067D02 and its explicitly slotted, statically BL-validated unwind is 0x080885C1 -> 0x08088F9F -> 0x0808F92D; 0x0808F957 is absent and 0x0202680C remains zero. This checkpoint proves only a stable prebattle menu, not controller entry or player control.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-prebattle-down
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: One audited Down from scenario-41-prebattle-menu selected the next prebattle row, and a fresh strict mGBA 0.10.5 zero-input replay preserved its exact normalized RGB screen, task-2 resume PC, explicit statically BL-validated unwind and 0x0202680C value. This accepted checkpoint does not prove battle controller entry or player control, and it does not independently authorize A or bypass the Step 4 A gate.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-pre-controller-after-a
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: Accepted lineage is accepted Down -> unique A -> zero settle 19. Two independent 19-frame zero-input replays preserved the full normalized RGB screen, task-2 resume PC, every explicit statically BL-validated active-unwind slot and 0x0202680C. This checkpoint remains pre-controller only, does not prove controller entry or player control, and has allowed_evidence=[]. The old bounded B -> zero -> B -> zero -> Down controller attempt from this state was superseded: a corrected subsequent child path captured the static-BL-valid raw return 0x0808F957, and two independent 224-frame zero-input replays created the canonical controller checkpoint. That later child acceptance does not change this record's own pre-controller status, path or evidence boundary.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-controller-entry
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: The corrected segmented path reaches a static-BL-valid active raw return 0x0808F957 and two independent 224-frame zero-input replays preserve exact RGB, task-2 resume/SP/LR, all three explicit raw returns and A880/A882/2680C. This accepted checkpoint proves stable controller entry only. The validator schema has no controller-entry hook token, so allowed_evidence remains conservatively empty; player control, first turn, MOVEDONE, victory and postbattle remain unproven.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-player-turn
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: The complete audit-hash lineage from the accepted controller-entry checkpoint contains exactly nine explicit A events; every intervening wait, settle, anchor, cycle and p64 replay has inputs=[]. Fresh ordered PCO1 selector (9,0,1) at 0x08073946 followed by PCA1 current slot 1 at 0x08073BAC binds the controlled WRAM unit record for character 1, affiliation 0 at (4,10). Base-ROM visible comparison and independent direct-call GDB evidence corroborate the boundary. This checkpoint is the accepted first player-control starting point only; MOVEDONE, victory and postbattle remain unproven.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-first-movedone-facing
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: This accepted checkpoint proves only a stable facing-direction prompt plus one observed fresh primary publication. The frozen evaluator returns verified=false with reason coordinates-unchanged, so it does not prove completed turn or accepted MOVEDONE evidence; victory and postbattle also remain unproven, and allowed_evidence stays empty.

checkpoints.name: scenario-41-first-turn-technique-menu
checkpoints.runtime_boundary: This accepted checkpoint proves only a stable unsubmitted technique-menu boundary. It does not prove technique submission, fresh MOVEDONE, completed turn, victory, or postbattle; allowed_evidence remains empty.
